notes: Mortgage and housing updates from primary public sources.

items.title: The average 30-year fixed mortgage rate was 6.65%
items.title_zh: 30 年固定房贷全国平均利率为 6.65%
items.summary: Freddie Mac's PMMS reported a 6.65% average, down from 6.67% the week before. The 15-year fixed average was 5.95%. These are national averages, not individual quotes.
items.summary_zh: Freddie Mac 的 PMMS 显示，30 年固定房贷平均利率为 6.65%，低于前一周的 6.67%；15 年固定房贷平均利率为 5.95%。这是全国平均值，不是个人报价。

items.title: Fannie Mae published its July economic and housing outlook
items.title_zh: Fannie Mae 发布 7 月经济与住房展望
items.summary: Fannie Mae's ESR group updated its outlook for mortgage rates, home sales, prices, housing starts, and mortgage originations. Forecasts can change with new economic data and are not individual loan quotes.
items.summary_zh: Fannie Mae 的 ESR 团队更新了房贷利率、房屋销售、房价、开工和贷款发放量预测。预测会随经济数据变化，不应视为个人贷款报价。

items.title: U.S. home prices fell 0.1% in April and rose 2.0% year over year
items.title_zh: 美国 4 月房价环比下降 0.1%，同比上涨 2.0%
items.summary: FHFA's monthly HPI reported a 0.1% national decline in April and a 2.0% increase from April 2025. The Pacific division increased 0.2% year over year.
items.summary_zh: FHFA 月度房价指数显示，美国独栋住宅价格 4 月环比下降 0.1%，较 2025 年 4 月上涨 2.0%；Pacific 分区同比上涨 0.2%。

items.title: HUD announced 14 FHA single-family policy changes
items.title_zh: HUD 公布 14 项 FHA 单户住房政策调整
items.summary: HUD said the changes cover appraisal reviews, Limited 203(k), lender quality control, and closing documents, with the goal of reducing duplicate requirements and process costs.
items.summary_zh: HUD 表示，新调整涉及评估复核、Limited 203(k)、贷款机构质量控制和部分交割文件，目标是减少重复要求并降低 FHA 贷款流程成本。
